title: toggle button immediate input submit
rule: Toggle has two variants: `button` (immediate action) vs `input` (in a form) — always one default state; not a checkbox. Dual-cite Ant/Lightning immediate-toggle; Suomi names the form-input variant. Locked dual-cite by variant; no global winner.
pass_when: Button-toggle applies immediately with no extra confirm; input-toggle waits for submit — or Ant/Lightning always-immediate switch used as that school on that surface. Checkbox is not the state-change control. Always one default state.
fail_when: Button-toggle requires extra confirm; input-toggle applies immediately while treated as a submit-time form control; checkbox used for state change; a global “all switches immediate” house rule that erases the variant split.
